_why: Owner policy 2026-10-11, verbatim: "nothing should be paid ... cut the probes and make them free."

The repo's OpenRouter key now has a $0 monthly credit limit. Every model call in this repo goes through loop/llm_router.py, which sends ONLY the models below, in this order, with a per-request max price of 0, and fails loudly if OpenRouter ever reports a non-zero cost.
There is no paid fallback. A refused key is the named stop OPENROUTER_KEY_DISABLED_OR_INVALID; no free model answering is OPENROUTER_NO_FREE_MODEL.

Refresh: fetch https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (no key needed), keep only ':free' text models priced 0/0 with >= 32k context, strongest general instruct model first, update snapshot_date. loop/tests/test_llm_routing.py enforces the shape.

Owner 2026-10-12, verbatim: "use my claude subscription usage in advance of the $0 openrouter". subscription_route (her prepaid Claude subscription via the headless Claude Code CLI, no per-call bill) answers first when CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is set; any failure there falls through to the $0 list below.
Owner 2026-10-12: GEMINI_API_KEY (her AI Studio key, free tier only) puts gemini_route's models between the subscription and the list below; they are ranked in the same route ledger.

Owner 2026-10-12: the order below is a SEED, not a ranking. loop/llm_router.py standing() measures it from loop/state/llm_route_ledger.json (every call outcome and every draft verdict) and walks the measured order. Seeded from run 38235183608 (Mon 12 Oct 2026): nemotron-3-ultra returned an EMPTY answer and cost ~5 minutes before the route moved on, so it started last. Re-seeded from the 2026-10-12 bench (seeded_from_bench): the OpenRouter models now follow the bench ranking, ultra first - it wrote 1,290-1,513-word drafts where super truncated or came back empty - and the route ledger carries the bench's attempts (lane "bench"), so standing() reproduces that ranking.

Bench 2026-10-12 (research/free_model_bench/2026-10-12.md): nemotron-3-super, -ultra, -3.5-lightning and dots-3-note spent the whole 16,000-token max_tokens on hidden reasoning and returned empty text (finish_reason=length). reasoning_max_tokens caps that thinking (OpenRouter `reasoning.max_tokens`, the form every listed model accepts; `effort` is not - ultra takes only high/medium - and `exclude` still spends the budget); max_tokens 24000 fits a ~1,500-word script plus that budget. loop/llm_router.py reasoning_problems() pins the shape.

seeded_from_bench.why: Owner 2026-10-12: the ranking of research/free_model_bench/2026-10-12.md, in route-ledger ids. loop/state/llm_route_ledger.json was seeded from the same file (python3 loop/bench_free_models.py --seed-ledger <file>); loop/tests/test_measured_fallback.py case (i) checks standing() reproduces it.

subscription_route.why: Owner 2026-10-12: her Claude subscription (prepaid, no per-call bill) answers first; the $0 OpenRouter list below is the fallback. Never an API key, never a paid model.

gemini_route.why: Owner 2026-10-12: her existing AI Studio key, free tier (10-15 req/min, ~250-1500/day per model); never a billed project. Behind the subscription, ahead of the OpenRouter list because Gemini Flash writes long-form far better than any :free model there. Whether 3.5 is on the free tier is unknown (key probed 2026-10-12: 62 models visible), so 403/404/429 on any model falls through with one [gemini-route] line. Data rule: free-tier prompts may be used by Google to improve its products - channel scripts only, never anything confidential (LP names, deal terms); this repo holds nothing confidential. Order re-seeded from the 2026-10-12 bench: gemini-2.5-flash (the bench's nearest miss) and gemini-3-flash-preview first, the unbenched lite models next, gemini-3.5-flash (503 in the bench and 4 errors on the Monday run) last; standing() reorders them by measured pass rate.
